source_plan_node_preserved.input_receipt: G0 dictionary/rule hashes and exact source locators

effective_state: Accepted G0 variable-year dictionary, source units and codebooks
diagnostic_status: See hash-bound run evidence; not inferred from this contract

audit_output_contract.publication: Only screened aggregate outputs copied to release/outputs. Private run root is recorded in run-manifest.json; .dta intermediates are outside the repository.
audit_output_contract.existence_and_execution: Declared artifact names; actual existence/hash/status comes only from the run manifest.

units.counts: named registry entries or checks; not plant counts

denominator: Every named registry item, source object, or required check, including unavailable and failed entries; metadata counts are not plant counts.
missingness: Keep source absence, unknown definition/unit, parse failure, observed zero/negative and valid positive states distinct. Unsupported statistical values stay missing, never zero.
row_reconciliation: Observation diagnostics preserve 33,049 unique obs_id. Method expansion checks 33,049 × declared method/sample combinations separately. Any filtering records marginal and sequential losses. Aggregates reconcile to their explicit fixed denominators.
input_output_contract: A validated numerical state and a typed unsupported receipt are distinct output types. A receipt cannot be consumed as the numerical state required by another estimator edge.
current_decision: Freeze this source as a distinct declared input; metadata availability does not waive substantive method gates.

blocked_dependencies.prices: Accepted concept-specific output/input/capital deflators and lineage-preserving real-value operands; current real/deflator fields are unavailable.
blocked_dependencies.capital: Accepted capital-stock concept AND measurement unit, plus separately verified positive real investment. capital_stock_verified certifies questionnaire concept only, not measurement admission; additions and mixed aliases cannot replace stock.
blocked_dependencies.technology: Verified two-digit technology bridge across questionnaire/classification vintages; demo_industry2 is not a certified bridge.

numerical_output_privacy: Record-level intermediate/output datasets remain local/private; only appropriate aggregate diagnostic tables and receipts are published.
